name: Zhan
source:
Eniri's family friend, he is a smith who has joined in on the business of selling magic trinkets. He will be there to support Shar as she adapts to her new home. He is unaware of the shady practices going on in his old friend's basement.

[From [url=https://www.rollingcrown.com/ice_demon/]official website[/url]]
